cards.title: Reduce repetitive manual work
cards.problem: Teams spend too much time on repetitive tasks, leaving less time for customers and business growth.
cards.solution: Identify one recurring task and test a simple workflow using a form, spreadsheet or automation tool.

cards.title: Turn website visits into enquiries
cards.problem: Visitors may leave a business website without understanding what the company offers or how to make contact.
cards.solution: Make your services clear, add a visible enquiry button and ensure the contact form works well on mobile devices.

cards.title: Make project progress visible
cards.problem: Clients and teams can lose track of completed work, pending tasks and upcoming deadlines.
cards.solution: Use a shared task board with task owners, due dates, status updates and agreed milestones.

cards.title: Reduce duplicate data entry
cards.problem: Entering the same information into multiple tools can waste time and introduce errors.
cards.solution: Map where the information is repeated and investigate whether a simple integration or shared system can reduce duplication.

cards.title: Choose the right technical resource
cards.problem: Hiring without a clear scope can lead to mismatched skills, unclear responsibilities and delayed delivery.
cards.solution: Write down the required skills, deliverables, expected availability and communication requirements before selecting a developer.
